notes: PB-06 (R-PROGRESSION-BETA, PR #407): kid words for the Seal families, seal ranks #1-15 and the three Strikes. Words only: no effect numbers, no game code. Family map is the plan's section 4.4 (the Programmer's file seal-families.json copies ids, names and text from here). Rank 'name' keeps the current names unchanged: the S4 table names in drafts/planning/S4-self-defense-powers.md (all are proposals; the name-clash list in G2B-02 stays a list of proposals). 'technique' is the self-defense number. 'oldSeal' is the placeholder Seal in abilities.json whose effect lands on that rank (plan 4.4). 'carries' are the two old Seals that ride on a rank (Steady Breath on the last Counter rank, Strong Block on the last Guard rank); both keep their current names. 'effectRef' only points at the S4 effect; amounts are placeholders until PB-09. 'status' marks a rank whose effect is not built yet. Kid wording: Great Counter (S4 still says Perfect Counter), capital STRIKE, DASH and COUNTER, no digits, one sentence under 80 characters. Seal text for #31-40 (Injured status) is elsewhere. Kata power lines wait on Jay (PB-11). ui.sealLocked is just the belt name: the school belt name already ends in Belt, so the code fills {belt} with the full name (for example Orange Belt) and adds no word after it.

families.name: Escape
families.text: Slip out of the way, then answer back.

ranks.name: Off the Line
ranks.text: A Great Counter adds two quick punches.

ranks.name: Other Side
ranks.text: A Block fills your DASH right back up, so you can step away.

ranks.name: Drive Back
ranks.text: A Great Counter pushes the attacker back and leaves them off-balance.

ranks.name: Slip and Double
ranks.text: Great Counters add a third quick punch and give you a little more time.

families.name: Counter
families.text: Make your Great Counters hit wider and harder.

ranks.name: Spin Back Fist
ranks.text: A Great Counter also knocks into enemies close by.

ranks.name: Spin Elbow
ranks.text: The spin of your Great Counter reaches farther and hits harder.

ranks.name: Arm Wrap
ranks.text: A Great Counter keeps the attacker trapped a little longer.

ranks.name: Palm Heel
ranks.text: Your Great Counter hits a bit harder.

ranks.name: Grab and Strike
ranks.text: Enemies who are off-balance or trapped take extra damage.

carries.name: Steady Breath
carries.text: Each Great Counter gives you back a little Health.
carries.effectRef: healOnPerfect (amount is a placeholder until PB-09)

families.name: Guard
families.text: Make your Blocks do more than block.

ranks.name: Block and Strike
ranks.text: Blocks bounce some of the hit back at the attacker.

ranks.name: High Block Strike
ranks.text: Blocks bounce back even more and leave the attacker off-balance.

carries.name: Strong Block
carries.text: Your Blocks take a little less damage.
carries.effectRef: blockCut (amount is a placeholder until PB-09)

families.name: Disarm
families.text: Make an attacker's next swing weaker.

ranks.name: Kick the Weapon
ranks.text: A Great Counter kicks the weapon aside, so their next hit is weaker.

ranks.name: Kick and Spin
ranks.text: Your kick lasts longer: their next two hits are weaker.

families.name: Throw
families.text: Great Counters can tumble enemies to the ground.

ranks.name: Outside Reap
ranks.text: A Great Counter tumbles a brute or swarmer to the ground for a moment.

ranks.name: Reap and Finish
ranks.text: Enemies you tumble take extra damage while they are on the ground.

families.name: Lock
families.text: Locks are coming later, so keep training!

strikes.name: Spin Kick
strikes.text: Your starting STRIKE: one strong spin kick.

strikes.name: Jumping Spins
strikes.text: Jump and spin for a few quick kicks in a row.

strikes.name: Butterfly Flow
strikes.text: A slower butterfly kick that lands extra hard.

emptySlots.strike: Spin Kick is ready. Earn more Strikes at the dojo!
